trial_title: Does Pregabalin Improve Symptoms of Anxiety in Patients With Epilepsy? A Comparison With Sertraline
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to compare the safety \& efficacy of sertraline (up to a dose of 200mg/day) \& pregabalin (up to a dose of 300mg/day) for the treatment of symptoms of anxiety in patients with epilepsy.
